source_text: Historical records trace the practice to ancient Egyptian artifacts circa 2400 BCE, evolving into a covenantal symbol in Judaism (Genesis 17:10-14) and a sunnah in Islam, where discontinuation could erode intergenerational transmission of identity and foster social fragmentation. [72]
